## What does this change and why?

Fixes #<!-- issue number, or write "n/a" for tiny fixes -->

## How was it tested?

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, type-check, tests, build)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behavior I changed
- [ ] For changes to screens: I checked it on a phone-sized and a desktop-sized window
- [ ] For changes to the API or storage: I ran `npm run e2e -w api` (see docs/OPERATIONS.md)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and focused (one thing per pull request)
- [ ] No personal data, secrets or real participant names anywhere (code, tests, screenshots)
- [ ] User-visible text is in `web/src/strings.ts` (or the page components of `web/src/site`)
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is released under the project's license (MIT)
